subject: APAC / EU automatic reroute opt-in and validation — immediate action requested
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Sana Gupta <sana.gupta@fintechco.com>, FinTechCo Ops <ops@fintechco.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: APAC / EU automatic reroute opt-in and validation — immediate action requested

Hi Sana / FinTechCo Ops team,

Quick update and an ask: starting ~07:40 UTC we detected elevated 5xx error rates and connection resets affecting a subset of our APAC and EU hostpaths. Root cause at the moment appears to be a control-plane throttling event at one of our cloud networking providers that intermittently impacted handshake completion for inbound traffic to eu-west and ap-southeast clusters.

What we recommend for impacted tenants (including FinTechCo): opt-in to Redwood's automatic_reroute policy for the next 4–8 hours so we can transparently move traffic to healthy regional endpoints and edge proxies while the provider applies the fix. Opting in will: 
- Switch live traffic to the next healthy region (US-east / us-central) with per-tenant prefix pinning disabled during the window.
- Enable a sidecar-proxy path that preserves KV cache warmup and mitigates cold-start token overhead for short-lived sessions.

How to opt-in (two choices):
1) Self-serve: Console -> Deployment -> Reroute Policies -> choose "Auto Opt-In (temporary)" and select FinTechCo account. Link: https://console.redwood.com/reroute/policies/auto-optin-42
2) Let us do it for you: reply with "OPT-IN FOR FINTECHCO" and we'll enact and validate.

Validation & rollback: after we enable reroute we run a light traffic verification (see attached validation_checklist.csv). If latency or quality drops exceed thresholds we'll roll back automatically. Expected latency delta is +25–60 ms for APAC->US routing under normal conditions; cost delta depends on token volumes (we'll share an estimate in follow-up).

Attachments: redwood_automatic_reroute_runbook.pdf (step-by-step) and validation_checklist.csv.

Please reply with the option you prefer. If you'd like Redwood to push the change, tell us the earliest minute window to apply (we can do immediate).

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0197

---

(Technical note for FinTechCo: this opt-in changes routing at the proxy layer only; we do not change your model version pinning. If you rely on very low-latency local region affinity for cross-token KV cache assumptions, there is a short warmup period we account for in the checklist.)
